name: Techo International Airport
notes: Techo (VDTI) is the current Phnom Penh airport; VDPP is closed, so it is not listed. The Cambodian eAIP (aim.cats.com.kh) needs a log-in, so no AD 2 data could be verified. A Cambodian government page (Economic Diplomacy unit, 20 Oct 2025, reprinting a Kiripost article) gives a 4,000 m x 60 m runway, about 20-26 km south of Phnom Penh, managed by CAIC with VINCI Airports; this is a news reprint, not the AIP, so it is not used as a fact. Checked 2026-10-27. | 2026-11-06 run: nothing recorded. Web reading was blocked this run: WebFetch permission requests were not answered, and the network proxy refused downloads (HTTP 403) from every official host tried (caasanwebsitestorage.blob.core.windows.net, aipchile.dgac.gob.cl, gcaa.gov.ae, aisweb.decea.mil.br); only web search worked, which gives no source text. Note: the task brief named VDTI as Chiang Rai / Mae Fah Luang (Thailand); that is wrong, Chiang Rai is VTCT. This file stays Techo International, Phnom Penh (Cambodia).
